description: Interpreting lists of literal lists as a propositional conjunctive normal form gives exactly the models of the corresponding finite set of finite clauses.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.list_cnf.{u} {α : Type u} [DecidableEq α]
  (v : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.Valuation α)
  (L : List (List (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.PropLiteral α))) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.eval v (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.Propositional.cnfFormula L) = true ↔
    Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.Models v (Lemmatheca.ProofTheory.Resolution.ofCnf L)
